preparation.title: Water in two different containers, and one ordinary log
preparation.text: Clock Tower: bring 1 bucket of water for the hot black cog. Fill a bucket at the well by Cedric, east of the tower; a bucket also spawns there. The cogs and rat poison are found in the tower dungeon. Ice gloves are an optional substitute for the water bucket. Monk's Friend: bring 1 ordinary log + 1 jug of water . Chop a normal tree with your axe; buy a jug at a general store and fill it at a fountain/sink. Cedric needs a jug, so the Clock Tower bucket is the wrong container. The child's blanket is recovered in the quest's cave. Hazeel Cult: no outside quest item purchases. The cult-side path avoids a fight and obtains poison from Clivet and the key/scroll from the Carnillean house. If you choose the Ceril branch, bring your starter weapon and food for the quest fight; finish the butler-evidence ending and final conversation, rather than stopping at the first small payment. Full completion awards 2,000 coins and 1,500 Thieving XP.

preparation.title: Plague City and Biohazard: groceries, water, clothes and the early fight
preparation.text: Plague City groceries: use the Hazeel reward for 1 dwellberries, 1 chocolate dust and 1 bucket of milk from Hudo's Grand Tree Groceries (normally 12 coins total). Walk north-west from Ardougne to the Tree Gnome Stronghold's southern gate, continue north to the Grand Tree, climb one floor above ground and find Hudo in the north-west corner. The shop needs no Grand Tree quest completion or spirit-tree unlock. Wait for stock or use another world if needed. Plague City tools and water: bring 1 rope, a spade, the three groceries and the 1 snape grass picked before sailing. Buy a missing rope at Aemad's Adventuring Supplies in East Ardougne; a spade and an empty bucket spawn by Edmond's house in north-west East Ardougne. The garden needs four uses of a bucket of water : refill that bucket at the house's sink between uses, or bring four filled buckets. Alrena makes the gas mask from the dwellberries. For Bravek's cure, add chocolate dust to the milk, then add the snape grass. Finish the quest and keep the mask; replace it from the cupboard in Edmond's house if lost. The grass has now been consumed, separately from future prayer potions. Biohazard fight: bring the retained gas mask, starter bronze sword (or your axe), wooden shield if still owned, and 10 whole cakes . Hazeel Cult already covers the 5 Thieving needed to steal these cakes in the market. The quest supplies the medical gown, bird feed, pigeon cage, key, distillator and samples as you progress. Its upstairs level-13 Mourner has 19 HP and a max hit of 2 : start at full HP, use ordinary melee and eat back toward full around 6 HP on a fresh account. If the fight is dragging, retreat downstairs while at least two cakes remain, restock and return. This is a food buffer, not a new combat-level or prayer-flicking requirement; leave at least four inventory spaces for quest items. Biohazard delivery and clothes: Captain Barnaby at the East Ardougne docks sails to Rimmington for 30 coins ; budget another 30 for the return after the Varrock delivery. Hand the three chemicals to the Chemist's helpers as directed, then travel to south-east Varrock and recover them there. Teleporting does not destroy the chemicals or plague sample. Ask Asyff , in the clothes shop just north of the Dancing Donkey Inn, for the free priest top and bottom during the quest. If that once-free set was already claimed and lost, buy replacements for 12 coins . Finish with Elena and King Lathas, then rebank for the diary. Keep the gas mask afterwards for Desert Treasure. These are separate quest inventories. Count items actually retained, use the completed quests' coins for the purchases, and replace food consumed before starting the next activity. Plague City · Biohazard .

preparation.title: All ten Easy tasks, including silk, the rusty sword and the Wilderness lever
preparation.text: Prepare the sword: after Biohazard, check actual 15 Thieving and take food to the H.A.M. hideout north-west of Lumbridge . Picklock the trapdoor, descend and pickpocket female H.A.M. members until you actually receive one rusty sword . This is a random drop, so there is no fixed pickpocket count. One sword is required; a second is optional insurance. Carry 100 coins per identification attempt (200 is a small two-attempt buffer), plus the diary silk and separate boat fares. This sword source needs 15 Thieving; the diary itself only needs 5. Take an ordinary return boat to Ardougne, then bank between the town, southern and lever tasks. Sell the bought silk: give the East Ardougne silk merchant one unnoted silk for 60 coins , asking for 120 first and accepting 60 after his counteroffer. Do this before stealing silk in the next route step. If you already stole silk recently, spend ten consecutive minutes outside Ardougne without logging out before trying again; buying a fresh piece does not cancel his refusal. Steal a cake: successfully steal an actual cake from a market bakery stall at 5 Thieving. If the earlier food pickup already ticked the diary entry, it is done. Cromperty: right-click Teleport Wizard Cromperty in north-east East Ardougne to enter the rune essence mine, then leave through its portal. Rune Mysteries is complete; no pickaxe or mining is required. Town church altar: switch on Thick Skin until a Prayer point drains, then pray at the East Ardougne church . This task uses the church in town, not the monastery altar. Probita: right-click Check Probita in East Ardougne to inspect insured pets. You do not need a pet or an insurance payment. Combat Training Camp: after Biohazard, enter its gate north of West Ardougne . No fight or ranged equipment is needed for the entry task. Fishing Trawler: walk to Port Khazard , board Murphy's boat on an official Fishing Trawler world and wait for it to depart and the task to tick. No Fishing level, successful catch or Angler outfit is required. After credit, ask Murphy to return to shore, then use a barrel to reach the shore north of Port Khazard, then walk south to the docks; keep a little HP for the swim. You do not need repair supplies for this departure-only trip. Tindel Marchant: at the southern Port Khazard dock, pay 100 coins to identify the rusty sword. Talking alone is insufficient. A rare junk result fails the task: obtain another rusty sword and pay another 100 coins if that happens. Aleck: walk south-west to Yanille and open Aleck's Hunter Emporium. No purchase or Hunter level is required. Wilderness lever: return to an Ardougne bank and deposit everything in the inventory and every equipped item . Pull the lever west of the castle into deep Wilderness, then immediately pull the arrival lever to return. Stay inside the enclosure; no knife is needed for this return. Re-equip and withdraw supplies afterwards. Check all ten entries in the Easy Diary list , then claim the reward from Two-pints in the Flying Horse Inn , north of the castle in north-west East Ardougne. The reward is Ardougne cloak 1 and a 2,500-XP lamp ; Two-pints replaces a lost cloak for free.

route_steps.visible_checkpoint: Complete Clock Tower , Monk's Friend and Hazeel Cult as three separate quests. After each quest, bank if the next inventory would be cleaner. Two pickups before the first ship: buy 1 silk for 3 coins from the silk trader north of Al Kharid palace; the free northern entrance avoids the Lumbridge gate toll. Pick 1 snape grass from the peninsula west of the Crafting Guild, without entering the Guild. Start that pickup at full HP, bring the starter cooked food and run past the hobgoblins, then walk back to Port Sarim. This grass is for Plague City, and this silk is for the diary; neither belongs to the later potion or eleven-silk reserves. First trip to Ardougne: take the ordinary Port Sarim ship to Karamja for 30 coins , walk west to Brimhaven, then pay Captain Barnaby 30 coins to sail to Ardougne. Bring food for the walk; these ordinary boats do not need a teleport unlock. Get Ardougne cloak 1 on this first visit Now complete Plague City → Biohazard → Ardougne Easy Diary , banking between each activity. Rune Mysteries is already finished. The diary needs 5 Thieving ; the completed Hazeel Cult and Biohazard give 2,750 Thieving XP in total, enough for 16 , so they also cover the 15-Thieving rusty-sword source below. No Fishing level, fairy-ring unlock or 30 Herblore is needed to obtain the cloak. Keep the cloak equipped or in your inventory: its unlimited, rune-free Monastery Teleport lands south of Ardougne beside an altar. It gives +2 Prayer bonus while worn . Run north to the southern Ardougne bank and the city, or north-east to Captain Barnaby's dock for 30-coin passenger trips to Rimmington or Brimhaven . These boats need no Sailing level or personal ship. This is a monastery teleport with useful places nearby; the easy cloak does not teleport directly to a bank or Farming patch. Two later transport connections: after Tree Gnome Village in 1.2 , walk west/north-west from the monastery to the Khazard Battlefield spirit tree. After Fairytale II's fairy-ring permission in 1.3 , take your dramen staff and walk east past the Tower of Life to ring DJP . The cloak gives convenient access to these entrances; each network still needs its own unlock. Use this lamp once: the Easy Diary lamp needs a skill at actual level 30 and cannot be banked. If you already have 30 Herblore, use it there. On the fresh route, keep it only until 30 Firemaking during the immediately following grind , then put its 2,500 XP into Firemaking and continue to the existing target. This is a deliberate exception to the usual Herblore-lamp advice so you get the cloak now without an extra Herblore grind or a long inventory burden. Do not destroy it: this diary lamp cannot be reclaimed. Later Herblore minimums do not count it.
